notes.title: Deckline needs your reviews!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

To begin with, huge thanks to everyone who bought our game and left feedback regarding the project. Your support, participation, as well as valid critique and ideas, have helped us in many ways, financial, psychological, and creative. We've made many discoveries and learnt even more!

Your reviews [b]immensely[/b] help the game's exposure and influence how Steam shows our game to other users, affecting the metrics directly. If you have played the game and have yet not left a review, help us out, [b]SUBMIT A REVIEW ON STEAM[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481320/Deckline/

Also, don't forget about our [url=https://discord.gg/95J7RcpCFG]Discord[/url]! If you'd like to talk to the developers and other players, feel free to hop on our server! It's the best place to stay up to date with everything related to our studio and games!

notes.title: Get Deckline & The Backrooms 1998 Bundle!
notes.content:
[h2]Haven't bought Deckline yet?[/h2]

[b]Now, it's 100% the right time![/b] We've bundled up with The Backrooms 1998, found footage survival horror game! Get both of our games, including Deckline, now and enjoy a nice bundle discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53801/The_Backrooms_1998_x_Deckline/

[i]The Backrooms 1998 is a gritty, found-footage style survival horror game where you must escape the claustrophobic, ever-changing maze of the Backrooms while being stalked by something unspeakable. Stay quiet, stay hidden, and survive the nightmare. The monster can hear your voice.[/i]

By the way, don't forget to leave your reviews to Deckline on Steam! We really need them for the game's exposure, our morale, and other algorithmic stuff on Steam's end. Also, join our [url=https://discord.gg/95J7RcpCFG]Discord[/url] and have some fun with us!

notes.title: May 8, 2025 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]

Thank you all for playing the game and sharing your feedback! It means the world to us. We are monitoring your suggestions, comments, feedback 24/7 to see what can be done to improve the general gameplay experience. 

Please note that [b]we have seen your multiplayer requests[/b]! This is a feature that we are ready to implement, however, we will be looking at the game's current performance to see whether creating multiplayer mode will be viable for us or not. Thank you for your understanding!

[h2]Hotfix[/h2]
[list]
[*]Direct artillery hit chance reduced to 20%.
[*]AI turn and card placement speed set to minimum delay.
[*]Resolved performance issues on some AMD devices.
[*]Improved overall performance across all hardware configurations.
[/list]

Don't forget to leave your reviews on Steam! If you are experiencing any technical issues, please, reach out to us via [url=https://discord.gg/95J7RcpCFG]Discord[/url] or any other format you prefer.
